title: Peritus · physical theater
question: A bolder hand: choose the physical mechanism your workspace should inhabit. Industrial materials and explicit labels remain binding.

options.label: The project vault
options.thesis: Projects are orange steel drawers; pull a session forward and hinge its lid open into a full conversation.
options.lineage: Archive box stacks translated to industrial storage
options.viewport: Labeled project drawers stack along the left; the selected drawer opens across the remaining screen, with nested tab flaps.
options.risk: Drawer movement must be brief enough for rapid switching.

raised.raise: Operational counts and state are directly legible.
Depth ordering follows one consistent mechanical law.

options.label: The interference bench
options.thesis: An achromatic instrument surface refracts color only at active panel edges.
options.lineage: Cloud diffraction translated to optical metrology equipment
options.viewport: A broad clear conversation field is bounded by fine spectral seams; files and controls slide from the edges.
options.case: Strong content clarity; weaker physical identity than the drawer vault.
options.risk: The narrow spectral treatment may feel too restrained for full theater.

options.label: The Nixie console
options.thesis: A blackened-steel conversation console with depth-layered orange counters, engraved legends, and heavy mechanical keys.
options.viewport: Project channels span the top; the conversation occupies a recessed center display, flanked by files and illuminated operational counters.
options.case: Stronger industrial identification and clearer operational state than the drawer vault.
options.risk: Counters must show real observed quantities; dark material must retain readable contrast.

options.label: The character machine
options.thesis: A live character-grid instrument turns navigation and activity into one phosphor field.
options.viewport: Project and session labels sit in a character lattice around a readable transcript; activity density changes with actual work.
options.case: Strong coding-culture identification; denser notation weakens first-use clarity.
options.risk: The fixed grid must release to native image, audio, and long-text viewers.

options.label: The sliding-plate machine
options.thesis: Chalk, slate, and rust plates slide across hard shadows; the active conversation literally takes the light.
options.viewport: Session plates overlap beneath a project header; files form a side plane and the composer is a large inset control surface.
options.case: Stronger industrial identification and clearer nested depth than the drawer vault.
options.risk: Moving planes must never obscure active text or keyboard focus.

options.label: The process folio
options.thesis: Every session is an aligned process plate, with stable landmarks across planning, building, and review.
options.lineage: Seasonal botanical folios translated to process inspection sheets
options.viewport: The current conversation fills an inspection sheet, with sibling sessions registered behind it and a stage strip below.
options.case: Strong reading clarity; lower industrial identification than the vault.
options.risk: Folio warmth may reduce the heavy-duty character you requested.
